data.explanation: This is an order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) for a new mobile phone plan, not a bill or authority letter, so there is no deadline to react to. The SIM card and PIN/PUK will arrive separately by post. The contract runs for a minimum of 24 months and then continues indefinitely unless cancelled with one month's notice before the end of the minimum term. Keep this letter and the attached contract summary (Vertragszusammenfassung) for your records, and set a reminder before the minimum term ends if you want to cancel or renegotiate. No immediate action is required now.
